meta.name: One Pace – Loguetown
meta.description:
The final island before entering the Grand Line: Loguetown. Luffy and his crew drop anchor to stock up, sightsee, and pay their respects to the place where Gold Roger drew his last breath.

Arc 8 din One Pace: 4 episoade, capitole 96–100, Loguetown Arc (Novel). Acoperă episoadele One Piece 45, 48–53. Subtitrare în română.

videos.title: 01. Kitetsu III
videos.overview: Touting a fresh bounty issued by Marine HQ, Luffy and co. make landfall at Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed. Being the last stop before the Grand Line, the crew stocks up on supplies and sightsees.

videos.title: 02. Luffy Is Dead
videos.overview: Luffy arrives at the execution platform, only to be caught in Buggy and Alvida's trap. Sanji and Zoro rush to stop Buggy from poetically—and flashily—executing Luffy where Roger died.

videos.title: 03. The Legend Begins
videos.overview: With Buggy's plan miraculously foiled and Captain "White Chase" Smoker now entering the fray, it's a mad dash for the Grand Line as the hands of fate push the Straw Hats toward their destiny.

videos.title: 01.5: Special: Daddy the Father
videos.overview: Usopp manages to anger the brat daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Red Hair Pirate Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he offers him a risky way out.
